stemMd: A closed box in the shape of a right rectangular prism has a square base and a height of $10$ inches. The volume of the box is $360$ cubic inches. What is the total surface area, in square inches, of the box?
instructionsMd: Student-produced response. Enter your answer in the box. Do not enter symbols such as a percent sign, comma, or dollar sign.
explanationMd:
The surface area needs the side of the square base, which the stem does not give directly. Recover it from the volume first.

Let $s$ be the side of the base. The volume of a prism is base area times height:

$$s^2 \times 10 = 360 \;\Rightarrow\; s^2 = 36 \;\Rightarrow\; s = 6$$

A closed box has six faces:

- two square faces (top and bottom), each $6 \times 6 = 36$ square inches;
- four rectangular side faces, each $6 \times 10 = 60$ square inches.

$$\text{surface area} = 2(36) + 4(60) = 72 + 240 = 312$$

Check the volume with the side found: $6 \times 6 \times 10 = 360$ cubic inches, as given.

The word *closed* is doing work in the stem. Leaving out the top gives $276$; leaving out both square faces gives $240$. A box that is closed has all six faces.
